UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LEGAL STUDIES

INTERVIEW FOR THE POSTOFPART-TIME FACULTY IN UNIVERSITY

CHANDIGARH
Posts No. of
seats
Honorarium
Part-Time Faculty
(Law)
01 Rs. 43,275/- per month fixed
Interview for appointment of the aforesaid post to teach B.A.LL.B (Hons.),
B.Com.LL.B. (Hons.) and LL.M. classes will be held on 12th August, 2026 at
11 a.m. in University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
Minimum Qualification: Master’s degree with55%marks (50% marks in case
of SC/ST) or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever thegrading system
is followed) and UGC-NET / Ph.D. in Law,as per UGC REGULATIONS ON
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT OF TEACHERS AND
OTHER ACADEMIC STAFF IN UNIVERSITIES AND COLLEGES AND
MEASURES FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF STANDARDS IN HIGHER
EDUCATION, 2018
All the applicants are advised to send/submit their applications to the
Director, University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh
along with all self attested copies of their certificates and other relevant
documents including publications for verification along with the duly filled
application form and template pages 1 to 11available at:
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.
pdf on or before 7th August by 4:00 pm. (Late applications will not be
considered).
Candidates are required to report at 10 a.m. on the date of interview i.e. 12th
August, 2026. Physical presence of the candidate is mandatory at the time
of interview. Further, candidates are required to bring all the supporting
documents/certificates/publications in original.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw
any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they
are teaching at University Institute of Legal Studies, Panjab University,
Chandigarh as a Part-Time Faculty. The candidates are requested to keep on
checking the Panjab University and UILS website for further updates.
Sd/-
Director
